profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Technical Manager | Specializing in AI-Driven Real-Time Systems, GPU Optimization & Intelligent Broadcast Infrastructure (Go, C++, Python, TS)
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer & Technical Manager specializing at the intersection of Real-Time Systems Architecture and AI-Driven Data Intelligence. With over a decade of experience delivering mission-critical technology for the world’s most-watched live events (5x Olympics, 10x US Elections), I bridge the gap between high-performance engineering and emerging AI technologies.
 
I focus on building intelligent, low-latency systems that process massive datasets in real-time. My expertise lies in optimizing the entire stack—from GPU-accelerated rendering and AR/VR 3D environments to AI-integrated data pipelines and global infrastructure scaling.
 
Throughout my tenure at CNBC and Versant, I have led global teams to solve "impossible" technical hurdles, ensuring 99.99% uptime for stock-driven applications and live broadcasts. Currently, I am focused on the deployment of Generative AI and Agentic Workflows to revolutionize real-time media and financial data visualization.
 
Core Expertise:
 ● AI & Data: LLM Integration, Intelligent Data Pipelines, AI-Assisted Content Augmentation, Vector Databases.
 ● Real-Time Systems: GPU Optimization, Low-Latency Networking (NDI), Real-Time Financial Integration, High-Performance Computing.
 ● Graphics & Media: AR/VR (Unreal, Unity, Brainstorm), 3D Visualization, NCAM, On-Air Real-Time Graphics.
 ● High-Performance Stack: Go (Golang), C/C++, Python, TypeScript, Redis, MongoDB.
 ● Leadership: Managing Global Engineering Teams, Infrastructure Scaling, Stakeholder Presentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Directing the evolution of on-air broadcast networks by integrating AI-enhanced workflows for real-time stock and data visualization.
Optimizing GPU-intensive applications to support advanced rendering and machine-learning-based automation in live control room environments.
Leading global engineering teams to scale infrastructure capable of handling massive, high-velocity data streams for AI-driven insights.
Spearheaded projects on both high level and low level for technical staff, executives and stakeholders. Simplifying tasks with actionable items.
positions.insights: Team Management, 3D Studio Viz and +19 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
High-Stakes Delivery: Orchestrated technology for Olympic Games (2016–2024) and US Elections (2016–2025), ensuring seamless data integration and viewer experience.
AR/VR Innovation: Built and scaled complex AR/VR 3D studios using Unreal, Brainstorm, and Maya, integrating real-time data feeds for dynamic storytelling.
System Modernization: Developed .NET-based software integrated with iNews and transitioned legacy products to modern stacks using Angular (8.0+), TypeScript, MongoDB, and Redis.
Infrastructure Lead: Directed the scaling of global server infrastructure and Disaster Recovery (DR) stations; pioneered remote broadcast capabilities via NDI (Network Device Interface) during COVID-19.
Financial Systems: Integrated high-speed financial vendor data to create the industry's most efficient real-time stock reporting processes.
